subject: Re: Novus POC - access, success criteria, and provisioning
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Kumar <sanjay@novus.ai>
Cc: Hannah Li <hannah.li@novus.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Novus POC - access, success criteria, and provisioning

Hi Sanjay / Hannah \u0014

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC started next week: 

POC scope & success criteria (proposal):
- Evaluate Redwood inference for 10k monthly requests across 3 endpoints (chat, summaries, reranking)
- Latency: p95 < 250ms for 2k token requests in US-west region
- Cost target: <= $0.0025 per 1k tokens for steady-state
- Quality: >= 85% on our shared eval set (see attached)

Timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): Access provisioning + onboarding
- Week 1-2: Integration + smoke tests
- Week 3: Focused evaluation and quality validation
- Week 4: Wrap-up and recommendations

Access we need from Novus:
1) SSO invites for 3 users (Sanjay, Hannah, and one engineer)
2) IP ranges to allowlist for our temporary API keys (we'll provide ranges)
3) Any internal firewall/proxy rules that could block outbound HTTPS to our endpoint

Attachments: Novus_POC_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf (mutual action plan + eval checklist)

Next steps: 
- Sanjay/Hannah: confirm SSO target domain and three users to invite
- Novus: confirm any IP allowlist windows and timeline constraints
- We (Redwood): will provision temporary API keys and a sandbox endpoint once we have allowlist details

Looping in Ethan (SE) for technical onboarding and Dev (security) for IP/keys. Laura from CS will own the success checks and weekly cadence.

Thanks \u2014

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Kumar <sanjay@novus.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Li <hannah.li@novus.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novus POC - access, success criteria, and provisioning

Thanks Marissa \u0014 this looks good. A few answers and clarifications from our side:

- We'll want SSO via our Okta org (novus.okta.com). Please invite: sanjay@novus.ai, hannah.li@novus.ai, and devops+redwood@novus.ai.
- IP allowlist: we can allow ranges during the POC. Tentative windows: 2026-12-01 00:00 UTC through 2026-12-31 23:59 UTC. Our security team needs explicit ranges before enabling.
- We prefer not to share production data; we'll give a reduced dataset for evaluation.

Can you confirm how long the temporary API keys are valid, and whether we can rotate them mid-POC? Also, any onboarding doc for Okta SSO would help.

\u0014 Sanjay
Sanjay Kumar
Head of ML Platform, Novus AI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Kumar <sanjay@novus.ai>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Li <hannah.li@novus.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novus POC - access, success criteria, and provisioning

Thanks Sanjay \u0014 good to know. Short answers:

- Temporary API keys: we'll provision keys valid for 30 days by default; we can rotate them on request and provide a rotation plan (no downtime if you call rotate endpoint).
- Okta SSO: please see attached novus_sso_instructions.txt for the settings we typically need (SCIM provisioning optional). If you want SCIM, we can enable it after the POC.
- IP ranges: Ethan / Dev \u0014 can you propose the Redwood egress ranges for the allowlist and confirm whether we should use a single CIDR block or two?

I'll get the mutual action plan updated with the Okta and allowlist items once we have ranges from Dev.

Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Kumar <sanjay@novus.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Li <hannah.li@novus.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novus POC - access, success criteria, and provisioning

Hi all \u0014 tagging in the security details and temporary credentials plan.

IP allowlist suggestion (for the POC window 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-31):
- Primary egress CIDR: 52.23.64.0/22 (Redwood US-west POC pool)
- Secondary (fallback): 34.201.128.0/24

Temporary API key plan:
- Provisioning: we will create a scoped API key (sandbox) valid for 30 days tied to Novus POC project ID: NOVUS-POC-2026.
- Rotation: keys can be rotated via our console or API; we will provide a one-click rotate link and timeline for key swap (recommended 5 min maintenance window).
- Rate limits: default sandbox rate 60 req/min, burst 300. If you need higher throughput for smoke tests, tell Ethan and we can bump for the POC window.

SSO instructions: we reviewed the Okta domain. For quick setup we need a Redwood SP metadata endpoint (I'll send it to you). If you prefer, we can invite users directly to the Redwood console and link accounts after you enable SSO.

Next actions:
- Novus: confirm allowlist acceptance for the CIDRs above
- Ethan: prepare a small load test plan and advise if we should bump sandbox rate limits for Week 1
- Marissa/Laura: update mutual action plan and share calendar invites for weekly sync (Fridays)

Attachment: Novus_POC_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf (updated once allowlist confirmed)

Thanks \u0014
Dev Patel
Security & Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai
